parts: Male red and white born on May 2, 2006. Shoulder height: 25,20 cm. Weith: 6,300 Kg.
CHAMPION OF BEAUTY IN SPAIN, CHAMPION INTERNATIONAL
DNA-identified at the Real Sociedad Canina de España.

A dog from the best American and European lines: Symarun, Karyon, Moonglow, Souyen, Lashalimar, Karola, Lovebody, Corsini... 24 champions in his pedigree over 4 generations, 22 of them American and Canadian.

His show results could not have started better. On his first appearance in the ring in adult class, he won CAC, CACIB, Best Male, Best of Breed under specialist judge and breed breeder Mrs. Karin Bernardis (Austria) at Talavera de la Reina 2009, and was subsequently selected among the top 8 in Group in an extremely competitive Group IX under Mr. Norman Deschuymére (Belgium). Breed winner at both obligatory point shows held in Spain in 2009.

He has a lovely outline and plenty of bone. He has a beautiful, very expressive and sweet, large head, with a deep, well-defined stop, large, very dark eyes and large, aligned teeth, with barely any undershot jaw, a reverse scissor bite and a very short muzzle. Excellent front and rear angulation give him great movement, with strong drive from every angle, a beautifully set neck and a very straight back with a perfect tail set. His coat has incredible length and quality, and is very dense with good texture. He clearly reflects what our desired line and type mean to us. His temperament is wonderful too!!
I thank his breeders Maura and Ale for entrusting us with this fantastic dog.
Father of our litters D, E, F, G and H. He is the father of 6 of our champions.
